WITH top AS (
  SELECT first_name
  FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  GROUP BY first_name
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 2
)
SELECT 
  CASE idx
    WHEN 1 THEN s.AdmFName1
    WHEN 2 THEN s.AdmFName2
    WHEN 3 THEN s.AdmFName3
  END AS first_name,
  s.District AS district
FROM schools s
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS idx UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) v
WHERE CASE idx
    WHEN 1 THEN s.AdmFName1
    WHEN 2 THEN s.AdmFName2
    WHEN 3 THEN s.AdmFName3
  END IN (SELECT first_name FROM top)
ORDER BY first_name, district;

WITH bond_elem AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id,
         (CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END) AS pair
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE c.atom_id < c.atom_id2
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT pair, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond_elem
  GROUP BY pair
),
max_cnt AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS m FROM pair_counts
)

WITH cust_totals AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_cons ASC) AS rn
  FROM cust_totals
),
segment_agg AS (
  SELECT Segment, SUM(total_cons) AS sum_cons, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN sum_cons * 1.0 / cnt END), 0) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM segment_agg;
